description: FR-24's most easily-lost clause: "reopen clears resolved_at until re-resolved; history preserved in events". A ticket resolves, is reopened by the customer, and resolves again — resolved_at must be NULL in between and must carry the SECOND resolution's stamp afterwards, never the first.

steps.why: the customer replied inside the reopen window (FR-08); the ticket is unresolved again and the metric must say so
re-resolved: the stamp is the LAST transition into the state
